scripts.infra:restart: npm run infra:down && npm run infra:up
scripts.infra:workers:build: docker compose --env-file packages/secrets/cm-platform.env -f docker/compose.dev.yml build email-dispatcher
scripts.infra:workers:up: docker compose --env-file packages/secrets/cm-platform.env -f docker/compose.dev.yml up -d email-dispatcher widget-consumer-fast widget-consumer-slow
scripts.infra:workers:down: docker compose --env-file packages/secrets/cm-platform.env -f docker/compose.dev.yml stop email-dispatcher widget-consumer-fast widget-consumer-slow
scripts.infra:workers:logs: docker compose --env-file packages/secrets/cm-platform.env -f docker/compose.dev.yml logs -f --tail=200 email-dispatcher widget-consumer-fast widget-consumer-slow
scripts.prod-local:build: docker compose --env-file packages/secrets/cm-platform.env -f docker/compose.prod-local.yml build public-web svc-core email-dispatcher widget-consumer-fast widget-consumer-slow
scripts.prod-local:logs: docker compose --env-file packages/secrets/cm-platform.env -f docker/compose.prod-local.yml logs -f --tail=200 public-web svc-core email-dispatcher widget-consumer-fast widget-consumer-slow
scripts.api:dev: npm run api:deps:build && npm --workspace apps/svc-core run dev
scripts.email-dispatcher:dev: npm run email-dispatcher:deps:build && npm --workspace services/email-dispatcher run dev
scripts.widget-consumer:dev: npm run widget-consumer:deps:build && npm --workspace services/widget-consumer run dev
scripts.api:deps:build: npm run contracts:build && npm run auth:build && npm run logging:build && npm run messaging:build && npm run secrets:build && npm run email:build
scripts.email-dispatcher:deps:build: npm run logging:build && npm run messaging:build && npm run secrets:build && npm run email:build
scripts.widget-consumer:deps:build: npm run logging:build && npm run messaging:build
scripts.core:build: npm run api:deps:build && npm run api:build && npm run email-dispatcher:build && npm run widget-consumer:build
scripts.all:build: npm run contracts:build && npm run auth:build && npm run logging:build && npm run messaging:build && npm run secrets:build && npm run email:build && npm run api:build && npm run email-dispatcher:build && npm run widget-consumer:build && npm run public:build && npm run etl:build && npm run email-send-test:build
scripts.clean: npm run contracts:clean && npm run auth:clean && npm run logging:clean && npm run messaging:clean && npm run secrets:clean && npm run email:clean && npm run email-dispatcher:clean && npm run widget-consumer:clean && npm run api:clean && npm run public:clean && npm run etl:clean && npm run email-send-test:clean
scripts.core:rebuild: npm run api:clean && npm run core:build
scripts.all:rebuild: npm run clean && npm run all:build
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run api:dev
